_comment: Input of tools/t0/r1g/suites_status.mjs: the console logs of tools/t0/run_suites.mjs runs on the R1g tree, oldest first is not required (they are ordered by file time). Add a run by adding an entry; 'conditions' states only what a record shows and names that record. Logs under tmp/ are not in git: the generated file stores size, time and sha256 of each one.

sources.conditions: Cloud container, 2026-11-04. api.mapbox.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net were unreachable (curl http 000), so every map-dependent suite is red for that reason; stopped by the engineer after 25 of 79 suites. Record: docs/accept/R1G-STATUS.md lines of 2026-11-04 21:15 and 23:50.
Cloud container, 2026-11-04, the R1-specific suites only (10 selected); api.mapbox.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net unreachable. Record: docs/accept/R1G-STATUS.md line of 2026-11-04 23:50.
Cloud container, 2026-11-08, 8 suites selected; api.mapbox.com answered 200 and cdn.jsdelivr.net 301; T0_MAPBOX_UNREACHABLE not set. Record: docs/accept/R1G-STATUS.md line of 2026-11-08.

Cloud container, file time 2026-11-09. A full run (79 selected) that stopped after 40 suites (its summary says PARTIAL). Not described in docs/accept/R1G-STATUS.md; its static.legal row names release/R1g/dist. No load was recorded.

Cloud container, file time 2026-11-11. The last complete run: all 79 suites of the table as it was then have a row (13443 s). Node's proxy variables were not given to the suites: the four pagesfix rows ended in 0.4 to 0.6 s with 'TypeError: fetch failed' in ensureVendor before any test ran (summary tails). The task brief of 2026-11-13 says it ran under heavy machine load; the log itself has no load. Not described in docs/accept/R1G-STATUS.md; its static.legal and r1.seo rows name release/R1g/dist.

Cloud container, file time 2026-11-11, about 80 minutes after the full run. A re-run of the 28 suites that were not OK in it (tmp/r1g-pack/failids.txt) with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY set by hand in the shell (the first line of the log is Node's EnvHttpProxyAgent warning from the runner process); it stopped after 14 of the 28 (summary says PARTIAL). The tree is not named in the log; the task brief of 2026-11-13 calls it the partial re-run of the R1g regression. No load was recorded.

Cloud container, 2026-11-13, one suite, through the machine lock, with the proxy-aware runner (no manual environment: the runner added NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY itself) and a cold vendor cache (T0_AGENT=r1g-harness-after), so the suite had to fetch the Mapbox GL library with Node. Load recorded in the log.

Cloud container, 2026-11-13, the 16 static rows (--only static), through the machine lock, with the proxy-aware runner (no manual environment). Load recorded in the log; the machine was shared with other work, so the durations are not timing evidence.
